comment: Userland overlay: files shown read-only over sealed system directories without touching the system volume.
scripts/package_raw_boot.py reads this list: it stages each built file in out/boot/ioswitch/overlay/<path>,
adds the CDHash of every 'trust' file to the static trust cache (own module, launch-constraint category 0)
and lists each file's directory, with its optional 'boot-arg' gate, in ADT /chosen ioswitch-overlay.
The deploy script copies the staged tree to /private/var/ioswitch/overlay/ on the Data volume. At boot, after
the Data mount and before launchd, the kernel (IOSwitchRawMount.inc native_ioswitch_raw_overlay) union-binds
/private/var/ioswitch/overlay<directory> over <directory> for every listed directory whose gate is on.
Fields: path (absolute), source (relative to tree/), trust (signed Mach-O), mode (octal, default 0755 for
trusted code, 0644 otherwise), boot-arg (all files of one directory share it; 'a|b' shows the directory when
either boot-arg is non-zero, for directories features share).
union (optional): the directory to union instead of the file's own, an existing ancestor of path.
The audio HAL union (our plug-in + the BTAudioHALPlugin stub) is gated on switch-audio, like audiomxd itself.
